goal: 세션 범위 Stop 알림·Interrupt 재개·선택적 정적 검사·명백한 원격 쓰기 감지 훅 연결

R.description: Implementation, stdin smoke observations, discovered boundaries and limitations

B.description: Actual failed registered run before F1-F3 fixes with unchanged regression test input

G.description: Full fixed-source registered local verification: 332 tests, one skip, no failures

scope: related instruction, context and document links
constraints: No model/network/remote command execution or global trust changes
No automatic routing, continuation, package installation or application tests in hooks
Native host activation is separate from local stdin verification
decisions: Explicit per-session task binding; no inference from unrelated tasks
Existing evidence assessor and static check functions; metadata-only private storage

acceptance.condition: Stop은 연결한 작업만 검토하고 같은 누락 알림을 반복하거나 작업을 자동 재개하지 않는다
acceptance.method: Bound/unbound/session-isolated Stop tests and same-source runtime evidence mutation

acceptance.condition: Interrupt가 민감한 원문 없이 중단 메타데이터를 기록하고 SessionStart에서 재개 안내한다
acceptance.method: Interrupt payload exclusion, resume link and held-lock regression

acceptance.condition: PostToolUse는 변경된 지침/설정/문서만 선별해 로컬 정적 검사를 재사용하고 모델/전체 테스트를 실행하지 않는다
acceptance.method: Selective cache/config/race tests plus actual stdin doctor/agent-config smoke

acceptance.condition: PreToolUse는 명시적 원격 쓰기와 업로드를 감지하며 읽기/다운로드를 허용하고 실제 원격 명령을 실행하지 않는다
acceptance.method: Pure command classifier read/write/options/redirect/SFTP matrices; no remote execution

acceptance.condition: 공식 이벤트 계약·CLI·문서·등록 검사와 라우팅 미등록 상태를 유지한다
acceptance.method: Registered full local checks, CLI/stdin contracts and document links

next_action: Local implementation and verification complete. When using native hooks, review current definitions in Codex /hooks; preserve original task notes for future work.
